name: TriNet
summary: TriNet is a PEO that takes on certain employer duties under a service agreement while the client runs daily operations. It offers medical, dental and vision plans and a TriNet-sponsored 401(k), and it handles payroll and payroll tax compliance. It charges a flat monthly fee per worksite employee, set through a quote.

facts.text: TriNet states that a TriNet subsidiary is classified as a Certified Professional Employer Organization by the IRS, and lists ESAC accreditation since 1995.

TriNet charges a flat monthly fee for each active worksite employee, and its fee example uses 20 employees at a $150 PEPM rate for $3,000 a month. The example illustrates the math and is not a list price.
TriNet says its pricing plans are for new clients only and vary by region, industry, company size and scope of services.
TriNet requires a minimum worksite employee count but does not publish it; the number is given through the quote process.

plans.name: TriNet PEO
plans.notes: A flat monthly fee per active worksite employee, customized by company size, industry, location and services. The page does not publish the rate

hiddenCosts: Benefit premiums for medical, dental and vision are separate from the per-employee fee.
Add-ons such as background checks, drug screening and premium learning courses can cost extra.
Many PEOs, TriNet's FAQ says, also charge a one-time onboarding or implementation fee.
